007package com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.profile;
008
009import com.oracle.database.selectai.Profile;
010import com.oracle.database.selectai.SelectAI;
011import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.DbConnectionConfig;
012import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.SelectAIException;
013import org.slf4j.Logger;
014import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
015
016/**
017 * Sample for translating text with a Select AI profile.
018 *
019 * <p>This sample demonstrates how to create a {@link SelectAI} client, obtain a {@link Profile} object, call the translate methods, and print the translated response.</p>
020 *
021 * <p>Required environment variables:</p>
022 * <ul>
023 *   <li>SELECTAI_DB_USER</li>
024 *   <li>SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD</li>
025 *   <li>SELECTAI_JDBC_URL</li>
026 *   <li>SELECTAI_PROFILE_NAME</li>
027 *   <li>SELECTAI_TRANSLATE_TEXT</li>
028 * </ul>
029 *
030 * <p>Optional environment variables:</p>
031 * <ul>
032 *   <li>SELECTAI_TRANSLATE_SOURCE_LANGUAGE</li>
033 *   <li>SELECTAI_TRANSLATE_TARGET_LANGUAGE</li>
034 * </ul>
035 *
036 * <p>Example {@code SELECTAI_JDBC_URL}:</p>
037 * <pre>{@code
038 * jdbc:oracle:thin:@mydb_high?TNS_ADMIN=/path/to/wallet
039 * }</pre>
040 *
041 * <p>Before compiling or running this sample, build the SDK jar and copy runtime
042 * dependencies. Run the dependency copy command after {@code mvn clean install},
043 * because Maven {@code clean} removes the {@code target/} directory.</p>
044 * <pre>{@code
045 * mvn clean install
046 * mvn -Psamples -DincludeScope=runtime -DoutputDirectory=target/dependency dependency:copy-dependencies
047 * }</pre>
048 *
049 * <p>Compile this sample:</p>
050 * <pre>{@code
051 * javac --release 17 -cp "target/select-ai-java-1.0.0.jar:target/dependency/*" -d samples/out samples/src/main/java/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/profile/TranslateProfileSample.java
052 * }</pre>
053 *
054 * <p>Run this sample:</p>
055 * <pre>{@code
056 * java -cp "samples/out:target/select-ai-java-1.0.0.jar:target/dependency/*" com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.profile.TranslateProfileSample
057 * }</pre>
058 *
059 * <p>This sample prints normal result data to standard output so it is easy to
060 * read when run from a terminal. It uses the logger only for error reporting
061 * and diagnostics.</p>
062 */
063public final class TranslateProfileSample {
064    private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(TranslateProfileSample.class);
065
066    private TranslateProfileSample() {
067    }
068
069    public static void main(String[] args) {
070        String profileName = requiredEnv("SELECTAI_PROFILE_NAME");
071        String text = requiredEnv("SELECTAI_TRANSLATE_TEXT");
072        String sourceLanguage = optionalEnv("SELECTAI_TRANSLATE_SOURCE_LANGUAGE");
073        String targetLanguage = optionalEnv("SELECTAI_TRANSLATE_TARGET_LANGUAGE");
074
075        try {
076            SelectAI selectAI = createSelectAI();
077            Profile profile = selectAI.profile(profileName);
078            String translated = translate(profile, text, sourceLanguage, targetLanguage);
079
080            System.out.printf("Translated response:%n%s%n", valueOrEmpty(translated));
081        } catch (SelectAIException e) {
082            LOGGER.error("Failed to translate text for Select AI profile '{}'.", profileName, e);
083        }
084    }
085
086    private static String translate(Profile profile,
087                                    String text,
088                                    String sourceLanguage,
089                                    String targetLanguage) throws SelectAIException {
090        if (sourceLanguage == null && targetLanguage == null) {
091            return profile.translate(text);
092        }
093        if (sourceLanguage == null) {
094            return profile.translate(text, targetLanguage);
095        }
096        return profile.translate(text, sourceLanguage, targetLanguage);
097    }
098
099    private static SelectAI createSelectAI() throws SelectAIException {
100        DbConnectionConfig dbConnectionConfig = DbConnectionConfig.builder()
101                .dbUser(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_USER"))
102                .dbPassword(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD"))
103                .jdbcUrl(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_JDBC_URL"))
104                .build();
105
106        return SelectAI.create(dbConnectionConfig);
107    }
108
109    private static String requiredEnv(String name) {
110        String value = System.getenv(name);
111
112        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
113            throw new IllegalStateException("Missing required environment variable: " + name);
114        }
115        return value;
116    }
117
118    private static String optionalEnv(String name) {
119        String value = System.getenv(name);
120        return value == null || value.isBlank() ? null : value;
121    }
122
123    private static String valueOrEmpty(String value) {
124        return value == null ? "" : value;
125    }
126
127}
